snippet.title: Macross Last Frontier (2011) Playthrough (PS3)
snippet.description:
Welp, here comes another playthrough to yet another Macross game. This time it's Macross Last Battle originally released as a hybrid pack with Sayonara no Tsubasa on October 20th, 2011. In this game you play as various pilots from Macross Frontier taking on various missions. I played about 5 missions for this game. I bought this game from Amazon.co.jp via White Rabbit along with Star Ocean 2 vol 2 manga, Lyrical Nanoha A's Blu-Ray, Saint Seiya: Santuary Battle on the PS3, some bottles of C.C. Lemon and a couple of bags of chips. And yes, there is some fun to be had here. Not absolutely amazing, but decent. 'Nuff said. 

All rights belong to Big West, Bandai Visual and Bandai Namco Entertainment.
